site.title: Divizion Launcher — The Ultimate Minecraft Launcher
site.description: Divizion Launcher is the free and uncompromising Minecraft launcher. Install your modpacks easily, manage your instances and launch Minecraft in one click.

home.title: THE ULTIMATE
home.description: Free and uncompromising. Install your mods, manage your instances, and play — no friction, no mandatory account.
home.featuresSubtitle: Everything you need for an uncompromising Minecraft experience.
home.migrationSubtitle: Automatically import all your instances, mods and configurations from your old launcher in just a few clicks.
home.communitySubtitle: Join our Discord server to chat, get help and follow the latest project news.
home.downloadsSubtitle: Total number of Divizion Launcher downloads.
home.readySubtitle: Download Divizion Launcher for free and start playing in seconds.
home.modrinthSubtitle: Modrinth is built directly into the launcher. Install any content in just a few clicks, fully automated.
home.modrinthShowcaseTitle: All of Modrinth, right in your launcher
home.modrinthShowcaseDesc: No need to look for your mods elsewhere. Everything is accessible in a few clicks from Divizion.

features.activityCenterDesc: Everything is centralized here. Whenever the launcher does something, it will be displayed here: re-indexing, downloading a modpack, launching one or more instances, or any other download.
features.liveLogsDesc: Dedicated area to view logs of running instances.
features.freeForAllDesc: Everyone can use the launcher, without an account or Minecraft premium. This means that in addition to being able to play Minecraft for free, we won't impose ads, restricted features, or mandatory accounts.
features.easyInstallDesc: You can install any modpack or mods in just a few clicks. It will instantly appear on your home page. Track the download just like an app on your smartphone.
features.quickLaunchDesc: With the Ctrl + K shortcut, you can launch any instance instantly, without clutter, quickly, and automatically minimize the launcher to the background.
features.multiInstanceDesc: View the launch of your instances or their status in real time directly from the activity center.
features.customUIDesc: Choose from 3 view modes to play your favorite instances, and use the sidebar to quickly access relevant details of your instance.
features.storageManagerDesc: Precisely view the storage usage of Divizion Launcher on your computer.
